skill.name: seo-content-refresher
skill.description: Reviews existing SEO content for outdated dates, statistics, examples, terminology, links, and topic gaps, then creates a prioritized refresh plan.
skill.summary: Create prioritized plans that keep aging SEO content accurate, useful, and competitive.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks in SKILL.md. The skill contains only content-refresh guidance and no executable commands or prompt injection.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 uses inline Markdown backticks around a relative documentation path. It does not invoke a shell or instruct command execution.
Lines 75 through 84 form a fenced Markdown example of a content refresh plan. The block contains no executable shell or Ruby command.

content.value_statement: Older pages lose accuracy, relevance, engagement, and search visibility as facts and expectations change. This skill produces focused audits and prioritized refresh plans.
actual_capabilities: Identifies outdated dates, statistics, examples, terminology, links, and references in supplied content.
Prioritizes pages using ranking loss, traffic decline, seasonality, engagement, and information accuracy.
Creates page-level refresh actions and update checklists.
Suggests missing sections, current trends, FAQs, internal links, media, and schema updates.
Organizes refresh work into a priority queue and publishing calendar.
limitations: It cannot verify current facts without reliable source material or research access.
It does not directly edit websites, analytics platforms, sitemaps, or schema markup.
It cannot guarantee ranking improvements after publication.
Its recommendations require editorial review and platform-specific validation.

use_cases.title: Recover Declining Articles
use_cases.description: Audit high-traffic articles that are losing positions and create specific update actions.

use_cases.title: Maintain Editorial Accuracy
use_cases.description: Find aging statistics, examples, links, and terminology before scheduled content updates.

use_cases.title: Plan Client Refresh Campaigns
use_cases.description: Convert page inventories and performance signals into a prioritized monthly refresh queue.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this article for outdated dates, statistics, examples, terminology, and links. List each issue and suggest a practical update: [content]
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single page

prompt_templates.title: Build a Refresh Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a refresh checklist for this page. Include accuracy, topic gaps, internal links, FAQs, media, metadata, and schema considerations: [content]

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize a Content Inventory
prompt_templates.prompt: Prioritize these pages for refresh using traffic, ranking change, engagement, age, and seasonality. Explain each priority and recommend next actions: [page data]

prompt_templates.title: Design a Refresh Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a quarterly content refresh program for [site]. Use this inventory and business goals to define tiers, workflows, owners, checks, and scheduling: [inputs]

output_examples.input: A 2023 cybersecurity trends article with declining traffic and several old market statistics.
output_examples.output: High priority. Replace old statistics with sourced current figures, add recent threat developments, review links, update examples, and revise metadata after substantive edits.

output_examples.input: A stable evergreen guide with one broken link and terminology that changed this year.
output_examples.output: Medium priority. Replace the broken source, update terminology consistently, confirm screenshots and FAQs, then retain the existing structure.

output_examples.input: A list of seasonal buying guides with traffic, ranking changes, and publication dates.
output: Refresh declining high-traffic guides before their demand period.
Schedule stable guides after urgent accuracy updates.
Review product availability, prices, links, images, and seasonal metadata.

best_practices: Provide full page content, publication dates, performance trends, audience details, and reliable current sources.
Prioritize factual accuracy and meaningful additions before changing visible dates or metadata.
Review every recommendation with editors and subject experts before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not update publication dates when the page has no substantial improvements.
Do not replace statistics without checking source quality, date, scope, and context.
Do not refresh every page equally without considering impact, urgency, and business value.

faq.question: What content should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the page text, URL, publication date, audience, goals, and available performance data.

faq.question: Can this skill verify new statistics?
faq.answer: It can assess supplied sources, but current claims need reliable research access and editorial verification.

faq.question: Does refreshing content improve rankings?
faq.answer: Useful updates may support performance, but rankings also depend on intent, competition, authority, quality, and technical factors.

faq.question: How are refresh priorities assigned?
faq.answer: Priorities consider ranking loss, traffic decline, factual age, seasonality, engagement, and the page's business value.

faq.question: Can it update my website directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides recommendations and plans, while implementation requires access to your publishing platform.

faq.question: How often should content be reviewed?
faq.answer: Review important pages regularly, especially before seasonal demand or when rankings, traffic, products, regulations, or facts change.
